DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 輪投げの輪をお返しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you returning the rings for the ring toss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。五つ借りましたが、袋に四つしか入りませんでした。一つを探してから返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸出五輪中四輪のみで一輪探索後返却を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I borrowed five, but only four ended up in the bag. I would like to find the other one before returning them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have only four of the five borrowed rings and want to find the missing one before returning them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のお手元には、四つございますね。遊んだ場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have four with you now, correct? Where were you playing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あのマットの前です。最後の輪がマットの向こうへ転がったので、陰にあるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の輪がマット向こうへ転がった場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of that mat. The last ring rolled beyond the mat, so it may be hidden behind it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show where the last ring rolled beyond the mat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場所を一緒に確認しましょう。袋は、今の四つを入れてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check that area together. Please put the four you have in the bag and bring it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この四つは袋にまとめます。残りを見つけたら、その一つも同じ袋へ入れて数えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四輪を袋へまとめ残り発見後合算すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: All right. I will put these four together in the bag. When we find the remaining one, I will put it in the same bag and count them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put the four rings in the bag and add the remaining ring once it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: マットの脇に、こちらの輪がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I found this ring beside the mat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これです。自分が最後に投げた青い輪です。四つへ加えたので、袋の中に五つそろいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い最終輪を特定し合計五輪を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is it. It is the blue ring I threw last. I have added it to the four, so all five are now in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the last blue ring and confirm that there are five in total. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 貸出の袋も、そのままお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return the bag you borrowed as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。輪五つと袋をお渡しします。探す間に落とした物がないか見てから、友人の所へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五輪袋を返し私物確認後友人へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here you are. I am handing over the five rings and the bag. I will check that I did not drop any belongings while searching, then return to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are returning the five rings and bag, and will check your belongings before returning to your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 五つと袋を確かにお受けしました。それでは、お友達とも楽しくお過ごしください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received all five and the bag. Enjoy the rest of your time with your friend. Thank you for using our equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の表示について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the train display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「始発」とあります。朝の一番早い列車のことだと思いましたが、今は昼です。どんな意味で書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼の始発表示を朝最早便と誤解し意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 'originating train.' I thought that meant the earliest train in the morning, but it is noon now. What does it mean here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook the midday originating-train display for the first morning service, and ask what it means.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示は、この駅から走り始める列車という意味です。朝の一番の時刻を示しているのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This display means the train begins its journey at this station. It does not indicate the earliest departure in the morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなんですね。この駅で待っていれば乗れる列車なのですね。発車の時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: この駅発と理解して発車時刻を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. So this is a train I can board if I wait at this station. Please tell me its departure time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the train starts at this station, and ask for its departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、午後一時二十分の発車です。行き先は緑川駅です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to this information, it departs at 1:20 p.m. Its destination is Midorikawa Station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一時二十分ですね。友人へ一時とだけ送ってしまったので、二十分を入れて伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空一時二十分を確認し友人への一時情報を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: 1:20, then. I sent my friend a message saying only one o'clock, so I will correct it by adding the twenty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional departure time of 1:20 and correct the one-o'clock information sent to your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先も緑川駅でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is Midorikawa Station the correct destination for you as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。行き先は合っています。始発と時刻を同じ意味で考えていたので、別々に紙へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行先緑川駅を確認し始発意味と時刻を別に控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the destination is right. I had been treating 'originating train' and the departure time as the same thing, so I will write them separately on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm Midorikawa Station as your destination and note the meaning of originating train separately from the time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車のご案内が始まりましたら、表示の乗り場へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When boarding is announced, please proceed to the platform shown on the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人へ発車時刻を訂正できました。この列車で緑川駅へ行くと伝え、案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人訂正済を報告し乗車案内を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I have corrected the departure time in my message to my friend. I will tell them I am taking this train to Midorikawa Station and wait for the announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you have corrected your message to your friend and will wait for the boarding announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、表示をご覧になってお待ちください。よいご旅行になりますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch the display while you wait. Have a pleasant journey. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 親子の工作教室へ、お申し込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for the parent-and-child craft workshop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子ども二人と私で参加します。材料は子ども二人分ほしいのですが、人数の欄には二人と書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子二人親一人で参加し材料二組の人数記入法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My two children and I will attend. We would like materials for the two children, but should I write two in the number-of-participants field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to enter the participant count when two children and one parent attend but need two sets of materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人数には、ご参加になる三人をお書きください。材料の数は、別の欄に二組と書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write three for the number of people attending. You can write two sets in the separate materials field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。人数は三人、材料は二組ですね。私も子どもと一緒に席へ座ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数三と材料二組を理解し親も着席すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Three participants and two sets of materials. I will sit with my children too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand there are three participants and two material sets, and that the parent will sit with the children too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。保護者の方は、お子さんの作業をお手伝いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Parents may help their children with the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は作品をもう一つ作るのではなく、二人の手伝いをします。子どもの名前も、それぞれ書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 親は第三作品作らず補助し子各名を記したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will help the two of them rather than make another item myself. I would also like to write each child's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the parent will help rather than make a third item, and would like to write each child's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お子さんのお名前は、この二つの欄へご記入ください。保護者名はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter your children's names in these two fields. The parent's name goes here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人の名前を書けました。保護者の欄には私の名前を書き、連絡先も私の携帯にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子二名親名と親携帯を各欄へ記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written both children's names. I will put my name in the parent field and use my mobile number as the contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter the two children's names, the parent's name, and the parent's mobile number in their respective fields. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人数と材料数を、最後にもう一度お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the participant count and number of material sets once more at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三人で二組になっています。子ども一人ずつに材料があるので、この内容で申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三人二組で子各一組を確認し申込を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It says three people and two sets. There is one set for each child, so I would like to submit the application with these details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm three people and two sets, one set per child, and ask to submit the application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お預かりします。親子での工作をお楽しみください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take your application, then. Enjoy making things together as a family. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体の絵で、伝えたい場所を示されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you marked the area you want to tell us about on the body diagram?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、鏡の写真を見て丸を付けたので、左右が逆かもしれません。自分の体で指して確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鏡写真で体図の左右を誤記した可能性を伝え身体確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I circled it while looking at a mirror photo, so I may have reversed left and right. I would like to point to my own body to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a mirror photo may have led you to reverse left and right on the body diagram, and ask to check on your body.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に気になる側を、ご自身の体で示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please point on your own body to the side that is actually bothering you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この右の肩です。絵には左の肩へ丸を付けてしまいました。実際に気になるのはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分右肩を指し図には左肩を印したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This right shoulder. I accidentally circled the left shoulder on the diagram. This is the side that is actually bothering me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to your right shoulder and explain in Japanese that you marked the left shoulder on the diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右の肩ですね。記入の訂正として、診察の担当へもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your right shoulder, then. Please also tell the clinician that this is a correction to what you wrote.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。右肩と書き足し、左の丸は間違いだと伝えます。紙だけを見ると違う側を説明してしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右肩文字を追記し左丸が誤記と担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will add the words 'right shoulder' and explain that the left-hand circle is a mistake. Looking only at the paper could lead me to explain the wrong side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will add 'right shoulder' and tell the clinician that the circle on the left is an error.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見て書いたことも、ご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also explain that you filled it in while looking at a photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鏡に映った写真を使いました。今は自分の右肩を指して、写真ではなく体を基準に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鏡像写真を使った経緯を話し実身体で位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I used a photo of a mirror image. Now I will point to my own right shoulder and explain using my body, rather than the photo, as the reference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you used a mirror-image photo, and indicate the location on your actual body.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この紙は、診察へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take this paper with you to your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。訂正した紙を持ち、右肩を指しながら説明します。ほかの丸も左右を見直してから渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正紙を保持し他丸の左右も見直して診察説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will bring the corrected paper and explain while pointing to my right shoulder. I will also check the left and right sides of the other circles before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the corrected paper, check left and right for the other circles, and explain at the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご説明ください。紙をお手元に残してお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please explain it to the clinician. Keep the paper with you while you wait. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われたカードを、お届けですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you bringing in a card you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。住所が書いてあるので、本人へ郵便で返そうかと思いましたが、先にこちらへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所入り拾得カードを本人へ郵送する前に警察へ持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It has an address on it, so I considered mailing it back to the owner, but I brought it here first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you brought a found card with an address to the police before mailing it to its owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現物はこちらでお預かりして確認します。どこで拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will take the actual card and check it here. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スーパーの前の歩道です。店の中ではありません。名前と写真があるカードを、そのまま拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スーパー外歩道で氏名写真付カードを拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the sidewalk in front of the supermarket, not inside the store. I picked up the card with its name and photo just as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you found a card bearing a name and photo on the sidewalk outside the supermarket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お時間も教えてください。カードを入れていた物は、ありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us the time too. Was there anything containing the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の午後三時です。ケースや財布はなく、この一枚だけでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 午後三時にケース財布なし一枚のみ拾得と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At three this afternoon. There was no case or wallet, just this one card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you found just one card at 3 p.m., with no case or wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 午後三時、歩道で一枚ですね。カードと一緒にほかの物を持ち帰ってはいないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: One card on the sidewalk at 3 p.m., then. You did not take any other items home along with it, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この一枚だけです。住所を封筒へ書く前に相談したので、まだ本人へ送っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ほか持物なしでまだ本人へ発送していないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct, just this card. I came to ask before writing the address on an envelope, so I have not sent it to the owner yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have no other found items and have not yet sent the card to the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届出のご案内をします。ご自身の連絡先を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain how to file the report. May I have your contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらの番号です。カードをお渡しします。本人の住所を控えて残すのではなく、自分の届出の控えを受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己連絡先を出し所有者住所控えでなく届出控えを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my number. I will hand over the card. I would like a copy of my report, rather than keeping a note of the owner's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide your own contact details and ask for a copy of your report rather than a record of the owner's address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、届出のご案内をします。お届けいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain the reporting procedure. Thank you for bringing it in. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の連絡先について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about the contact details for your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。受け取る友人は耳が聞こえにくいので、電話へ答えられません。文字での連絡を希望していると、送り状へ書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 難聴の受取友人が文字連絡を希望すると送り状記載可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend who will receive it is hard of hearing and cannot answer phone calls. Can I write on the shipping label that they prefer written contact?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can state on the shipping label that your hard-of-hearing recipient friend prefers written contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この送り状には、連絡のご希望を書く欄があります。受取人のご希望を短くお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This shipping label has a field for contact preferences. Please briefly state the recipient's preference there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人にも確認しました。「電話では応答できないので、文字での連絡を希望」と書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認済の電話非応答文字連絡希望文を記したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have checked with my friend too. I would like to write, 'Unable to respond by telephone; written contact preferred.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the recipient has confirmed their preference and you want to write that they cannot answer calls and prefer written contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご希望として配達の担当へ伝えます。連絡方法は、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will pass that preference on to the delivery staff. The staff will confirm the contact method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 配達の担当へ、その希望を伝えてください。友人には発送する前に知らせておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達担当へ希望伝達を頼み発送前に友人へ知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please pass that preference on to the delivery staff. I will let my friend know before sending the parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the preference to be passed to delivery staff, and say you will inform your friend before shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送り状には、受取人の連絡先も記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also enter the recipient's contact details on the shipping label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人が教えてくれた番号を書きます。私の番号に替えるのではなく、本人への連絡の希望です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人提供番号を記し自分番号へ置換しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the number my friend gave me. I am asking about their preferred way of being contacted, not replacing their number with mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will enter the number supplied by the recipient and will not substitute your own number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の欄と、連絡先を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the preference field and the contact details again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方を書けました。私から友人へも、発送することと、希望を送り状に書いたことを文字で送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望連絡欄と番号を見直し発送希望伝達を本人へ文字連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have filled in both. I will also send my friend a written message saying that I am shipping the parcel and have put their preference on the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Review the contact preference field and number, and send the recipient a written message about shipping and passing on their preference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、送り状を確認いたします。ご希望をお伝えいただき、ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the shipping label now. Thank you for telling us your preference. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取引明細の対象期間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me the period you need the transaction statement to cover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年の一年分です。ただ、四月から三月ではなく、一月一日から十二月三十一日までをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前年明細を四月年度でなく一月一日十二月三十一日指定で依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The whole of last year. But I would like January 1 through December 31, rather than April through March.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request last year's statement for January 1 through December 31, rather than an April-based fiscal year. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初の日と最後の日が、同じ年になる指定ですね。ご希望の年もご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the start and end dates should fall in the same year. Please enter the year you want as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二〇二五年です。二〇二五年一月一日と十二月三十一日を書きます。二〇二六年の分は必要ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二〇二五年両日付を記し二〇二六年分不要と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: 2025. I will write January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2025. I do not need any transactions from 2026.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Enter both dates in 2025 and clearly state that you do not need 2026. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その期間の明細を出力するお申し込みとして確認します。ご本人の口座ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will confirm this as an application for a printout of transactions during that period. This is your own account, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私の口座です。通帳を持ってきました。残高の一日の証明ではなく、その期間の取引が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己口座通帳を示し一点残高でなく期間取引が必要と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it is my account. I brought my bankbook. I need the transactions for that period, rather than proof of the balance on a single day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the bankbook for your own account and explain in Japanese that you need transactions over the period rather than a balance at one point in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご用意の方法と費用は、担当からご案内します。確認したいことは、ございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member in charge will explain how it can be prepared and the cost. Is there anything you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ページが何枚になっても、最初と最後の日が分かる形で受け取りたいです。抜けた月がないか自分でも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 複数頁でも両端日付が分かり抜月を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: However many pages there are, I would like it in a form that shows the first and last dates. I will also check myself that no months are missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that even across multiple pages you want both endpoint dates shown and wish to check for missing months.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も担当へお伝えします。日付の指定を、この用紙と合わせてお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that request on as well. Please show your specified dates together with this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。去年という一語だけでなく、二〇二五年の一月から十二月と指定して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年曖昧語でなく二〇二五年一月十二月指定を書面で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written them down. When I ask about it, I will specify January through December 2025, rather than just saying 'last year.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify January through December 2025 in writing rather than using an ambiguous reference to the year. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、対象期間を確認してご案内します。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will confirm the requested period and assist you. Thank you for preparing everything. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: バナナをお選びでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日食べる分と、数日あとに食べる分がほしいです。同じ房を二つ取るより、別の状態を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本日用と後日用で熟度の異なるバナナを見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like some to eat today and some to eat a few days later. I would like to look at different stages of ripeness rather than take two identical bunches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to see bananas at different stages of ripeness for today and a later day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは黄色くなった房、隣はまだ青い部分がある房です。食べる予定も考えてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This bunch is yellow, and the one beside it still has some green areas. Please choose with your planned eating time in mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の分は黄色い方にします。もう一つは三日後の予定ですが、必ずその日にちょうどよくなるとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本日黄色を選び後日三日目の状態は保証不可と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will take the yellow ones for today. The other bunch is for three days from now, but there is no guarantee it will be just right on that exact day, is there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose yellow bananas for today and show in Japanese that you understand their condition three days later cannot be guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態は変わりますので、ご自宅でもご確認ください。どのくらいの量をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Their condition changes, so please check them at home too. How much would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人なので、小さい房を一つずつにします。今日の分はすぐ分かるよう、袋を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単独食用に小房一つずつを袋別にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is just for me, so I will take one small bunch of each. I would like separate bags so I can easily identify the ones for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want one small bunch of each, in separate bags, for one person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの小さい房を、別々の袋へお入れできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can put these small bunches into separate bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。色を見て分け、今日の黄色い方は台所のすぐ取れる所へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色を見て本日房を手の届く台所へ置くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will separate them by color and put today's yellow bunch somewhere easily reached in the kitchen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish them by color and keep today's bunch within easy reach in the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの方も、お召し上がりになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will anyone else be eating them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今のところ私だけです。青い部分のある方は家で状態を見ながら食べる日を決めます。二つで会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後日房は自宅で状態を見て食日決め二房会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only me for now. I will decide when to eat the bunch with green areas by checking its condition at home. Please charge me for the two bunches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide when to eat the later bunch after checking it at home, and ask to pay for both bunches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの二房をお持ちください。ご利用いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these two bunches, then. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊びの時間を、こちらで計っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you timing your play here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと五分のゲームをしています。でも、持ってきた砂時計の砂が途中で止まって、終わったか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五分ゲームの砂時計が停止し終了時刻不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am playing a five-minute game with my child. But the sand in the hourglass we brought stopped partway through, so I do not know whether the time is up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about an hourglass stopping during a five-minute game, leaving the end time unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いったん遊びを止めて、お二人でどう続けるか話してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please pause the game and discuss together how you would like to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 止めました。子どもはまだ続けたいと言っています。残り時間が分からないので、最初から計り直すか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ゲーム停止し残り不明で最初から計り直すか子へ聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We have stopped. My child says they still want to play. Since we do not know how much time remains, I would like to ask whether we should time it again from the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you paused the game and want to ask your child about restarting the timing because the remaining time is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お手元に、別の時計はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have another clock with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯にタイマーがあります。子どもがよければ、砂時計をしまって、それで五分をもう一度計ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯タイマーがあり子同意なら五分再計測すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My phone has a timer. If my child agrees, I will put away the hourglass and use that to time another five minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a phone timer and will time five minutes again if your child agrees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お子さんの返事を確かめてから、始める時を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check your child's answer before deciding when to start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一度五分でよいと返事がありました。携帯に五分を入れ、一緒に開始を押します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子同意を得て五分設定し共に開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said another five minutes is fine. I will set five minutes on my phone, and we will press start together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Get your child's agreement, set five minutes, and start together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わりの音が鳴ったら、時間を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the end signal sounds, please check the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鳴りました。五分できました。今日はここで終えて、砂時計は家で様子を見ます。遊びの道具を片づけて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了音で五分完了し本日終了道具収納砂時計家で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: It rang. We have had our five minutes. We will finish here for today, and I will check the hourglass at home. We will put away the play equipment and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the signal confirms five minutes are complete, you will finish for today, put the equipment away, and check the hourglass at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、忘れ物をご確認ください。親子でお楽しみいただき、ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check that you have all your belongings. Thank you for enjoying some parent-and-child time here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か落とされたのでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: イヤホンが一つ、このベンチの下へ落ちました。奥に見えますが、手が届きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベンチ下の片耳イヤホンが見えるが届かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: One of my earbuds fell under this bench. I can see it toward the back, but I cannot reach it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can see one earbud under the bench but cannot reach it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの辺りか指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you point to where it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右の脚の後ろです。白い小さい物です。ベンチを動かさずに取れるか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右脚後ろの白物位置とベンチ未移動での確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Behind the right leg. It is a small white object. Could you check whether it can be retrieved without moving the bench?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the white item behind the right leg and ask for a check without moving the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの道具で届きそうです。少し離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It looks as though this tool will reach it. Please stand back a little and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ケースともう片方は持っています。ケースの空いた側は左なので、落ちたのは左です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースと右耳所持から落下左耳を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I have the case and the other earbud. The empty space in the case is the left one, so the one I dropped is the left earbud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have the case and right earbud, which shows the dropped earbud is the left one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り出せました。こちらの白いイヤホンをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have retrieved it. Please check this white earbud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内側に左の印があります。私のケースに入るので、この一つで間違いありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左印と自己ケースで取り出し品の一致を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a left-side mark on the inside. It fits my case, so this is definitely mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the retrieved item matches, using its left-side mark and your own case.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、ベンチの下へ落ちた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Has anything else fallen under the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかはありません。二つともケースへ入れて、かばんへしまいます。取ってくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他落下物なしと両耳ケース収納と感謝を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nothing else. I will put both earbuds in their case and put it in my bag. Thank you; retrieving it was a great help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that nothing else fell, you will put both earbuds in the case, and you are grateful.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お忘れ物なくお出かけください。よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Please make sure you have everything before you leave. Have a good trip.
